text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finding jobs for 6,000 young Bahrainis is a target this year, official says.
- The American Mission Hospital has raised nearly 400,000 dinars towards its first phase expansion project to start next year, official says.
- Peregrine Investments to close its Gulf branch office in Bahrain.
- Bahrain Aluminium launches two expansion and development projects at a cost of 19 million dinars, vice-president says.
- Bahrain's foreign minister says the Gulf Arab states' four-member committee will continue its mediation to solve the Bahrain-Qatar territorial dispute.
- Israeli goods were confiscated from Bahrain market, customs chief says.
